evidence_items.explanation: Sixteen participants supervised an autopilot under two reliability conditions lasting 45 minutes each. Reliability changed trust and perceived demand, but the study did not find the predicted increase in task-unrelated mind wandering, limiting the broad causal claim.

unresolved_gaps: The cited studies do not establish a continuous relationship as reliability approaches perfection.
Monitoring performance and subjective mind wandering are different measures.
The evidence does not directly test editorial oversight of generated articles.
